Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, and bacteriuria, with >100,000 CFU/mL Staphylococcus aureus cultured, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Findings are consistent with an active UTI; clinical correlation and prompt management are recommended, especially considering the patient’s advanced age.
